title: BCS Gap Equation on Riemannian Manifolds: A Heat Kernel Analysis
summary: In this paper, we investigate the Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) theory of superconductivity formulated on a three dimensional Riemannian manifold. We derive the gap equation in the path integral picture by employing a Hubbard-Stratonovich transformation followed by a saddle point approximation. Under the assumption that the length scale set by the metric is much larger than the healing length, we solve the gap equation to find a slowly varying gap function that exhibits the effects of curvature.
